messages:
Priya (sales): Heads-up — Acme POC hitting intermittent 429s during extended chat sessions. They reported token spikes after a few long-turn exchanges. Can we triage fast? cc @Logan @Satoshi
Ethan (infra): Can you paste a couple of request IDs + the exact route they hit?
Priya (sales): Req IDs: req_01f2a3, req_01f2b7. Route header shows: /v1/generate/chat (x-route: chat-default). Client says burst reached ~350 reqs in 10s window.
Logan (sre): 429s typically = per-route cap or daily token budget exhaustion. Are they doing retries on 429? Also: are they using streaming?
Priya (sales): They were streaming for some sessions but also doing batch calls from the web app. Some client retries were visible.
Satoshi (eng): Quick thought — client-side retries w/o jitter amplify spikes. Also streaming can hold connections and increase concurrency. Ask for their retry logic.
Priya (sales): Their snippet: ```js
// simple retry
for (let i=0;i<3;i++){
  try { await fetch('/v1/generate', opts); break;} catch(e) { await sleep(500); }
}
```
Maya (acct exec): Customer is asking for a temporary quota bump so their demo doesn't fail. How fast can we raise per-route cap for a trial account?
Ethan (infra): We can do a short override on proxy level but need ops sign-off. @quota-bot what's acme-inc current budgets?
quota-bot: Account acme-inc: token_budget_daily=2000000; per_route_limit=100/s; current_day_usage=1895200; last_update=1876543000
Logan (sre): They're at ~94% of daily budget and their traffic is concentrated into a 90m window. Two things: 1) temporary per-route bump to absorb short bursts, 2) coaching customer on exponential backoff + jitter and streaming.
Priya (sales): I asked them to pause non-demo traffic for 30m. Can we do a 2-hour temporary bump with guardrails (auto-revert at 2h or when usage >95%)?
Satoshi (eng): I can push a canary config: set-route-cap acme-inc chat-default -> 250/s TTL 2h and an auto-throttle rule when 1-min token rate > 0.95 of budget. Command (admin):
```
admin tools set-route-cap --account acme-inc --route chat-default --cap 250 --ttl 2h --on-threshold 0.95
```
Ethan (infra): Need ops authorization because this affects capacity planning. @Maya can you approve? Include reason: POC demo for Acme, risk of lost deal.
Maya (acct exec): Approved for 2h. Please annotate ticket with customer contact and demo window.
quota-bot: Action queued: route-cap-change acme-inc chat-default -> 250/s for 2h by Satoshi. ETA ~45s.
Logan (sre): Watching metrics — after override, 429s drop significantly. Also recommend: add server-side circuit-breaker and set client retry to exponential backoff + full jitter.
Priya (sales): Great — I'll tell the customer we applied a temporary bump and ask them to implement jitter + reduce retries. Will follow up after 2h with usage snapshot. Thanks all :tada:
